name: conditional-call-skipped
source: const reviewOld={run(){}};const reviewClean={run(){}};const reviewBox={api:reviewOld};function replaceReviewApi(){reviewBox.api=reviewClean;}async function runReviewScenario(){const reviewInfo=await window.desktopApi.app.getInfo();if(reviewInfo.hasEnum)replaceReviewApi();const reviewOther=reviewBox.api;reviewOther.outsideScope=window.desktopApi.outsideScope;window.BankStatementController.createBankStatementController({api:reviewOld});return reviewOther===reviewOld;}runReviewScenario();
